metric_schema.freshness: per-source as_of + class current|stale|stale_cached|conflicting|forbidden_payload; stale never injected as current; conflicting requires a conflict flag or clarification
metric_schema.injection_size: budget_chars and max_facts; legacy intent was 3 observations / 650 chars per fact, measured actual exposes the inert-limit defect
metric_schema.latency: budget_ms for retrieval + formatting only, excludes model generation
metric_schema.relevance: per-fact tier required|acceptable|forbidden; hard fail on any forbidden injected, fail on missing required (clarification allowed per pass_rule)
metric_schema.source_ids: every fixture source id declared for the case; injected facts are matched against these ids

pass_semantics: A case passes only for a FIXED selector. The current (unfixed) pipeline is expected to fail most cases; those failures are the labeled baseline that cards 04/05/07 compare against. Degenerate baselines (always-inject / never-inject) must each fail this set on different cases, which is itself a validity check.
